queries.sql:
SELECT p.period,
             SUM(p.amount) AS value
      FROM SNOWCONSO_AXA_DE.PUBLIC.V_PLAN_COMPOSED p
      WHERE p.version_id = 3 AND p.fiscal_year = 2026 AND p.module = 'revenue' AND p.account_code LIKE 'rev-%'
        AND p.dim_primary != 'ALL'
      GROUP BY p.period ORDER BY p.period
